content.comment_body: Hello! I have a demo version of [product_name] installed on my computer and noticed that not all transfer actions appear grayed out as expected. For instance, options like 'Set clock' or 'Read data Log' and a few others remain active. If selected, a communication dialog opens asking for an IP address and begins searching for a [product_name] controller. Is this intentional or simply a misleading menu item that can waste users' time?
Hi, which version of the [product_name] demo are you using? In my demo version [version_no], all the relevant actions are grayed out and no additional dialog appears.

Alright! That seems to be fixed in newer releases. The version I was referring to was [version_no], which is quite old. I have the full version [version_no], but I am unable to check how the demo mode menu behaves there.

analysis.insight_summary: A user noticed that in an older demo version of [product_name], some actions that should have been disabled were incorrectly shown as active and triggered dialogs, leading to confusion about software behavior. Newer releases addressed this by properly disabling these options and preventing unnecessary confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that non-functional or restricted actions in demo mode should be clearly marked or disabled, so that they don't waste time interacting with unavailable features.
